findings.description: Skills fetch has no independent error recovery. If getSkills() fails with non-404 errors, it's silently swallowed and treated as 'no skills available' rather than 'fetch failed.' Users won't know to retry. Consider distinguishing between these cases.

Suggested positions match percentages are hardcoded via Math.max(60, 95 - idx * 7). This synthetic calculation doesn't reflect actual backend confidence. If the API ever returns real match percentages, this code will need updating.
